description: This file defines the EntityGroupUtil class, which provides utility methods for handling entity groups, such as retrieving entity names by group and filtering model entities based on include/exclude rules and stamp fields.

classes.name: EntityGroupUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to retrieve and filter entity names and models based on entity groups and inclusion/exclusion rules.

methods.name: getEntityNamesByGroup
methods.description: Returns a set of entity names belonging to a specified entity group, possibly requiring stamp fields.

methods.name: getModelEntitiesFromRecords
methods.description: Filters and returns a list of ModelEntity objects based on include/exclude rules and stamp field requirements.
